title: The Journal
intro: Field notes from a travel advisor — destination guides, itineraries, theme park know-how and the stories behind the places I plan.
author_bio: Soukeyna is the travel advisor behind Voyage By Luna. She plans cruises, all-inclusive resorts, Disney and theme park trips, and destination weddings and honeymoons, and she holds a Korea Travel Specialist certification.
